summary: Full frontend e2e testing of DevNexus AI auth system (Login + 2FA) and all main navigation flows. All critical paths passed. Auth flow Login→2FA→Hub→Project works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Login form submits and navigates correctly but Playwright's first click attempt sometimes doesn't trigger (likely Fast Refresh race condition on first load). Works reliably on second attempt. No code fix needed - this is a test environment artifact.

Sidebar nav links (Tareas, Conexiones) navigation works when using data-testid ws-nav-{key} and direct URL navigation. visibleNavKeys is determined by project type (tipo.navItems) - all expected links present for ecommerce-v2.
mocked_apis: ALL auth and data is MOCKED - localStorage devnexus_session key, no real backend calls
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth system fully working: /login (email+password) → /auth/verify-2fa (6-digit OTP, TOTP/Email toggle) → /hub (project grid). Protected routes redirect to /login without session. setup-2fa shows QR code. Logout clears localStorage and redirects to /login. All sidebar nav links work (Dashboard, Tareas, Agentes IA, Scaffolding, Roadmap, Historial, Conexiones MCP, Ajustes). Tareas shows Kanban board with 4 columns. Conexiones MCP shows connection cards with filters.
tested_flows: ✅ Login page loads with email/password inputs and validation
✅ 2FA page: TOTP/Email toggle, 6-digit OTP inputs, code 123456 → redirects to /hub
✅ ProjectHub: grid of 5 projects (E-commerce V2, Tesis, App Clima, Informe Q1, Estudio IA) + Nuevo Proyecto card
✅ Filter tabs: Todos, Desarrollo de Software, Proyecto Universitario, etc.
✅ Sidebar nav: Dashboard, Tareas, Agentes IA, Scaffolding, Roadmap, Historial, Conexiones MCP, Ajustes all present
✅ Tareas page: Kanban with 4 columns (Pendiente, En progreso, En revisión, Completado) and task cards
✅ Conexiones MCP page: filter tabs and connection cards (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, GitHub, MongoDB, etc.)
✅ Protected route /hub without session → redirects to /login
✅ setup-2fa page: QR code shown with manual key and Continue button
